**Finding: compliant** (sits at/above the fallback) — no redline proposed.

**What the document says.** Section 8 carries a one-way indemnity in our favour:

- **§8.1 (p0086–p0087)** — Commerce One "shall indemnify, defend and hold harmless Corio and its Customers" against third-party claims that the Software infringes any patent, copyright, trademark or trade secret, including reasonable attorneys' fees, and extends the benefit to our own Customers.
- **Procedure** — prompt written notice, tender of control/defence/settlement to Commerce One at its expense and with its counsel, our cooperation at its expense, plus our right to join with counsel of our choice. Standard and acceptable.
- **Remedies (p0087)** — procure the right, replace/modify to make non-infringing, or terminate and refund a pro-rated portion of fees paid. The classic ladder.
- **§8.2 (p0088) exclusions** — use other than as documented, and third-party modification where the infringement would not have occurred but for it. These are the usual customer-modification/specification carve-outs.

**Direction and cap check.** There is no reciprocal Corio indemnity anywhere in the agreement (searches for "indemnif", "hold harmless" and a Corio-side obligation return only §8.1), so the asymmetry runs our way. Section 9 (p0090) expressly excepts "LIABILITY ARISING UNDER SECTION 8" from both the 12-month fee cap and the consequential-damages exclusion — the vendor indemnity is uncapped, which is better than the fallback's 3× annual fees super-cap.

**Noted in the rationale, not flagged.** The indemnity is IP-only: it does not reach Commerce One's breach of applicable law, unauthorised access to or disclosure of our data, or its gross negligence/wilful misconduct, as the preferred position would provide. The refund is also limited to a pro-rated portion of fees paid. These are sub-elements short of preferred wording rather than material failures of the fallback, so under the playbook's classification semantics they are recorded but not redlined. If this agreement is reopened for other reasons, adding limbs (b)–(d) of the model language would be the natural ask.
